value.headline: Iced Matcha Latte sales are outpacing hot Filter Coffee, but we're leaving money on the counter with low food attach rates

industry_trend.claim: UK matcha demand is rising and supply is constrained, with imports rising and prices under pressure; Perfect Daily Grind reports UK matcha imports worth £46m in 2025 and supply challenges due to heatwaves and aging farmers.

nudges.rationale: Miso Banana Loaf sales have fallen 21.9% in the last 4 weeks while Iced Matcha Latte demand remains strong (601 units/week on average). Reducing the bakery item and increasing matcha powder aligns stock with current demand and minimizes waste; the weekly opportunity from attach is £207.
nudges.title: Adjust this week's order: Reduce Miso Banana Loaf, increase Iced Matcha powder

nudges.rationale: Only 8.18% of matcha transactions included a bakery item in the verified data; increasing cross-sell by even one bakery item per ~12 matcha orders could lift weekly revenue close to £207 given current mix.
nudges.title: Train staff to upsell pastries with every matcha drink

nudges.rationale: Morning window accounts for a significant share of volume (55.9% during morning hours). Aligning staffing with the Tue 10:00–11:00 peak can improve service speed and throughput; no explicit GBP uplift data is provided in the facts for this nudge.
nudges.title: Optimize staffing for the Tuesday morning rush

value.sell_summary: Over 13 weeks, revenue £157,469 from 26,023 transactions; average basket £6.05. Filter Coffee is the top revenue driver at £44,612, while Iced Matcha Latte surges growth of 27.9% in recent weeks; Miso Banana Loaf has fallen 21.9%, and only 8.2% of matcha transactions include a cake/pastry item.
